title: Replace with the topic title
audience: who the learner is and what they already finished
focus: one sentence naming what the topic teaches and what the labs examine
must_not_contain: a term that belongs to a different topic (a file name, a product, a sample dataset)

data.sample.file: what the file holds and how its fields are numbered; the labs run on it

lab_questions: a question the labs should answer
avoid: content outside the topic's authorised scope
